title: Argilos, no irrigation, Bărăgan plain, mid-September
rationale: Same soil exclusion as the irrigated argilos case: argilos is in unsuitable_classes for grau_toamna, orz_toamna and rapita_toamna. No drought ordering is asserted between secara and triticale here even though the parcel is dryland: Reviga is the wettest brief in the set for the forecast window (48.3 mm over 16 days, 31.5 mm on day 0 alone) and has only 1 drought-flagged year in 10, so the dryland lever the Dăbuleni and Podu Iloaiei cases use is not supported by this brief.
